title: Occult-minded Nazis brought in through Paperclip and Overcast run the US space program

tellings.quote: Yeah, exactly. Running our space programs and then and uh and Overcast as well, right?

plain: After the Second World War, Germans with an interest in the occult were brought to the United States through Operation Paperclip and Operation Overcast, US programmes that recruited German scientists from 1945, and they went on to run the American space programme. That is what a researcher named Chris Ramsay says on the show, summing it up without naming a source. If true, it would mean the US space effort was shaped from the start by men with Nazi pasts and mystical beliefs.
